title: 2022 CODATA: classical electron radius is 2.817 940 3205 × 10^−15 m
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives classical electron radius as 2.817 940 3205 × 10^−15 m, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0013 × 10^−15.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives classical electron radius as 2.817 940 3205 × 10^−15 m, with uncertainty 0.000 000 0013 × 10^−15. The row is not marked exact. The uncertainty is the uncertainty printed on that row. The ASCII file does not split it into statistical and systematic parts. This length is the classical electron radius used in Thomson scattering. The ASCII row is a recommended value with an uncertainty.
